entries.afd22ac03003e0ec: A business that manufactures and sells construction machinery such as hydraulic excavators, ultra-large hydraulic excavators and wheel loaders, and also sells parts and services, supporting the entire flow from when a machine starts to be used until it is retired. In Japan, Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd. has the Tsuchiura Plant and Kasumigaura Plant (Ibaraki Prefecture) for hydraulic excavators and other products, the Ryugasaki Plant (Ibaraki Prefecture) for wheel loaders and other products, the Hitachinaka Plant and Hitachinaka Port Plant (Ibaraki Prefecture) for hydraulic excavator components and other products, and the Banshu Plant (Hyogo Prefecture) for recycling business equipment and other products; its subsidiary Hitachi Construction Machinery Tierra Co., Ltd. (Shiga Prefecture) makes mini excavators, and Hitachi Construction Machinery Camino Co., Ltd. (Yamagata Prefecture) makes some construction machinery products. Overseas, subsidiaries such as P.T. Hitachi Construction Machinery Indonesia, Hitachi Construction Machinery (China) Co., Ltd. (Hefei, Anhui Province), Tata Hitachi Construction Machinery Co.,Pvt.,Ltd. (India) and Hitachi Construction Machinery Eurasia LLC (Russia) have assembly plants. Sales and services are handled by subsidiaries: Hitachi Construction Machinery Japan Co., Ltd. in Japan, Hitachi Construction Machinery (Europe) N.V. in Europe, Hitachi Construction Machinery Sales (China) Co., Ltd. in China, Hitachi Construction Machinery Asia Pacific Pte.Ltd. in Southeast Asia, Hitachi Construction Machinery Oceania Holdings Pty.,Ltd. in Oceania, and Hitachi Construction Machinery America Inc. in the United States; in China, Hitachi Construction Machinery Financial Leasing (China) Co., Ltd. also conducts leasing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,268,519 million (¥1,243,914 million in the previous fiscal year), the larger of the 2 reportable segments. Consolidated revenue by product was ¥272,029 million for mining machinery and ¥1,133,464 million for construction machinery and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were firm in Europe and in the independently developed businesses in the Americas, and price increases also supported revenue. On the other hand, sales in the Americas OEM business and in Oceania decreased.
